selected_space.source: CH2(triplet) + HSS(doublet) inner C-S cleavage: select CAS(5,4), the two CH2 frontier directions, HSS radical and bound-sulfur donor. The CAS(3,3) near solution substitutes sulfur-rich character for one carbon bonding direction. The donor CAS restores its C/S character and changes the near-minus-far D1 energy by -2.9448/-2.9443 kcal/mol. Added occupation is 1.97873 near (DZ) and 2 at separation; the three frontier occupations become 1,1,1 far. Use natural 19-22, one quartet and one doublet with equal total weights; only D1 contributes flux. These are evidence-based chemical active-space choices. They do not certify quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular, relaxed-path or plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital/state/connectivity guards. Retain direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz CBS power 3.7, a separate 30 A asymptote, and the existing mapped correction coordinate and COM dividing surfaces. No existing production model is changed here.

selected_space.source: CH2SH(doublet) + S(triplet): select CAS(7,5). Retain all three atomic S3 p directions (four electrons), the molecular radical, and the occupied bound-S2 donor that participates in association. Compared with CAS(5,4), the donor changes the relative D1 energy by -3.4508/-2.9842 kcal/mol (DZ/TZ), with CI donor-hole configurations and near donor occupation 1.99050/1.98956. At separation it becomes 2, atomic p occupations are 4/3 each, and the radical is 1; all three doublets and three quartets coincide within 4e-7 Eh. Use natural 18-22, equal spin-block weights and equal roots within each block; only D1 contributes flux. These are evidence-based chemical active-space choices. They do not certify quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular, relaxed-path or plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital/state/connectivity guards. Retain direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz CBS power 3.7, a separate 30 A asymptote, and the existing mapped correction coordinate and COM dividing surfaces. No existing production model is changed here.
